headline: Ekko, Xayah and Kog'Maw lead patch 26.22
lede: More than half of the most-picked champions lose: 36 of the 65 picked in 5% or more of their role's games win less than half of them. Built on 1.9 million Emerald+ games from nine stat sites in Korea, Europe and North America, corrected for small samples and one-tricks.

takes.top: Singed is the outlier, with Kayle, Malphite and Shen behind him. Higher up Kayle and Singed lead Diamond+, Fiora leads Master+, and Malphite drops to A in both. Jayce and Yone are picked a lot and still lose, and Yasuo dropped more than anyone since last patch.
takes.jungle: Zyra, Wukong and Lillia lead, and Zyra is the outlier in Diamond+ and Master+. Rek'Sai scores even higher in Diamond+ but is picked in under 2% of those games, too rarely to count as one. Lee Sin is in 13% of games and loses, and Qiyana is the worst popular pick in the role.
takes.mid: Ekko is the outlier at every rank. Vex and Vladimir follow in Emerald+, Katarina and Zoe in Diamond+ and Master+. Mel gained the most since last patch and Viktor is up too, but Viktor is still a trap at 7.7% pick.
takes.adc: Kog'Maw and Xayah are ahead of everyone, and of the usual ADCs Corki gained the most since last patch. Ezreal is in 15% of games and has the worst score of any popular ADC.
takes.support: Rell, Zilean and Leona score highest in Emerald+, so pick what fits your bot laner. Rell is the outlier in Master+. Yuumi, Karma and Lux are popular and lose, and Thresh dropped the most since last patch.
